# Supplied landing-page export

`internal/console/landing/` contains the owner's supplied Framer export and a small original integration bridge. Its generated Framer runtime, React/runtime dependencies, fonts and design images are not relicensed as Agent Linux's original Apache-2.0 code. Preserve embedded copyright/license notices and the exported Framer attribution. The raw export is not modified or included in packages.

Source supplied by the repository owner: `site-export-1794633887436`, original export site `unique-structure-158589.framer.app`. Integration normalizes asset paths, disables external analytics/editor loading, connects local routes, corrects readiness claims and selects an existing smaller image variant. No third-party runtime code is used as a host executable.

The owner must retain appropriate Framer/template, font and image usage/distribution permissions before a broad public binary/site release. This notice does not assert that every generated asset is Apache-2.0 or independently license-verified. Original integration files carry their own SPDX notices.

The unified typeface uses Manrope variable from the official Google Fonts `ofl/manrope/Manrope[wght].ttf`, downloaded 2026-11-13 (SHA-256 `3ae11c49db0455a3cc33e37d380f20fdb8c7f8b41dc07625c177e3d87a9d6ae6`). Its SIL Open Font License is preserved alongside the font in `internal/console/landing/fonts/OFL.txt`. The visible Made in Framer marketing badge is hidden at the owner's request; embedded third-party copyright notices remain.
